citation.title: Evidence for a relationship between VEGF and BMI independent of insulin sensitivity by glucose clamp procedure in a homogenous group of healthy young men

reported.what: clamp M value (glucose infusion rate, mg/kg/min) by BMI group, mean and SEM, n=15 each; the minutes over which M was averaged are not printed (only that ISI used 'time point 65 until time point 105' of the VEGF figure, whose time origin is not printed)
clamp-period glucose and insulin by group (Table 1; insulin differs from the fasting-insulin P value, but the minutes averaged are not printed)
fasting glucose and insulin: only P values for group differences, no group means

location.quote: The three subject groups showed no difference in fasting glucose (P = 0.304) and fasting insulin (P = 0.160) levels.

reported.what: cortisol by group, printed in ug/ml (implausible unit), sample time not printed

detail: The only enterable numbers are the groups' M values, and the paper does not print the minutes over which M was averaged (nor the origin of the 'time point 65 until 105' used for ISI), so no window can be written without inventing one.
